description: This file defines the AppRepository class that manages app state, app information, locking/hidden status, and related preferences and scheduling functionalities within an Android application.

classes.name: AppRepository
classes.description: Repository class providing an interface to manage installed apps, hidden/locked app states, PIN security, rules, and scheduling within the app.

methods.name: observeInstalledApps
methods.description: Returns a Flow emitting a list of AppInfo objects representing installed apps with their hidden and lock status.

methods.name: toggleHidden
methods.description: Inserts or deletes a HiddenApp record to hide or unhide an app based on the 'hide' parameter.

methods.name: toggleLocked
methods.description: Inserts or deletes a LockedApp record to lock or unlock an app based on the 'lock' parameter.

methods.name: hasPin
methods.description: Checks whether a PIN is set in secure preferences.

methods.name: setPin
methods.description: Sets a PIN in secure preferences.

methods.name: validatePin
methods.description: Validates a provided PIN against the stored PIN in secure preferences.

methods.name: addRule
methods.description: Inserts a LockRule into the database and schedules it, returning its ID.

methods.name: removeRule
methods.description: Deletes a LockRule from the database and cancels its schedule.

methods.name: context
methods.description: Returns the Android Context object associated with this repository.
